title: CCCP
wikitext:
CCCP is a Russian QuakeWorld clan. Due to the differences between the Cyrillic and Latin alphabet, the clan is actually called ''SSSR''.

Reunited in the early 20s and took part in a couple of tournaments.

== History ==
Clan was renamed from USSR to CCCP prior to [[EQL Season 11]].
